architectureDecisions: D1 — Edit only packages/oracle/src/retrieval-planner.js reserve(). execute() budget checks stay on reservedBudget.

D2 — Drop Math.min(8192, remainingBytes) with no replacement constant. reserve() computes every magnitude as a share of the remaining budget: for READ_EXACT with R remaining itemRefs (this and later evidences) each work gets items=1 and materializedBytes=Math.max(1, Math.floor(remainingBytes / R)), so a single-itemRef evidence receives all remaining bytes; for TRAVERSE_GRAPH/FETCH_EXTERNAL items=Math.max(1, remaining.maxItems-reserved.items) and materializedBytes=remainingBytes; for REPOSITORY without itemRefs LOOKUP_SYMBOL, SEARCH_LEXICAL and STRUCTURAL_MAP each keep items=1 so both operations still reserve, and each gets materializedBytes=Math.max(1, Math.floor(remainingBytes / remainingCalls)) with remainingCalls=remaining.maxProviderCalls-reserved.providerCalls at reserve time, leaving one call-share of bytes for GRAPH_EXPANDED_V1 when the budget has headroom and zero when it is tight. execute() budget checks stay on reservedBudget. The superseded per-evidence-ops split (LOOKUP rem/2 + SEARCH rem) is revoked: it consumed all remaining bytes (10000+10000 of 20000, free 0) and starved GRAPH expansion.

D3 — RP1 in retrieval-planner.test.js: 9000-byte EXACT file, budget maxMaterializedBytes 40000, execute+facade COMPLETE with one candidate. This test fails on current main (BUDGET_EXHAUSTED). RP2: 9000-byte file with maxMaterializedBytes 100 stays UNSATISFIED BUDGET_EXHAUSTED and content is not truncated. RP4: REPOSITORY requirement with budget maxItems 3 / maxProviderCalls 3 / maxMaterializedBytes 20000 plans LOOKUP_SYMBOL and SEARCH_LEXICAL with items 1/1 and bytes 6666/6667, leaving free calls/items/bytes 1/1/6667 so GRAPH_EXPANDED_V1 still EXPANDs; tight budget 2/2/20000 leaves zero free so expansion still SKIPs. RP4 fails under the superseded D2 split (free bytes 0).
D4 — Keep execute() catch mapping: ProviderFailure.reason plus detail=error.message. Do not add code. Probe mappingKeys are evidenceId,providerId,reason,detail.

D5 — test/oracle-context-graph-boundary.test.mjs CG3 COMPLETE case currently asserts one path and truncated:true because items=1. After D2 TRAVERSE_GRAPH receives remaining maxItems (4 in that test), assert both importer paths and truncated false when both fit. packages/agentic-system/test/oracle-context-adoption.test.js comments about min(8192) stay valid as a lower bound if tests still pass; update comments if a 3*8192 comment would be false.

D6 — Living docs: docs/living/system/oracle/workflow.md and context-graph.md describe remaining-budget reservation with GRAPH headroom (base REPOSITORY plan leaves unreserved budget when the requirement has headroom), not a 8192-byte per-item cap. No Blackboard ids.

D7 — Evidence: planner-reservation-probe-result.json (9000-byte file, reserved 8192/1, facade UNSATISFIED BUDGET_EXHAUSTED) plus plan-defect-probe-result.json (delivered base 8192+8192=16384 free 3616 EXPANDED 2 candidates; superseded D2 split 10000+10000=20000 free 0 SKIPPED 1 candidate; corrected split 6666+6667=13333 free 6667 EXPANDED with RP1 40000 covering 9358 need and 100-byte oversize fail-closed).
